standard_prerequisites.name: The backward heat equation in measure form (eq: heatmeasure)
standard_prerequisites.statement: A smooth one-parameter family of probability measures (mu_t) under generalized Ricci flow satisfies the backward heat flow when d_t mu = -Delta mu.
standard_prerequisites.use: Cited at statement line 691 (the hypothesis: mu solves the backward heat equation) and again at proof line 699 through the shifted endpoints mu(t'+u), mu(t''+u); declared as a navigation stub carrying the article's printed number.

standard_prerequisites.name: The backward heat equation in density form (eq: heatdensity)
standard_prerequisites.statement: For mu_t = rho_t e^{-f_t} dV_t the backward heat flow is equivalent to d_t rho = -Delta_f rho + R^{H,f} rho on the density.
standard_prerequisites.use: Cited at proof line 708 to substitute d_t rho and identify grad phi with grad log rho; declared as a navigation stub.

standard_prerequisites.name: The backward-heat-equation lemma (l:rhoBHE, printed 3.5)
standard_prerequisites.statement: The equivalence lemma between the measure form and the density form of the backward heat equation.
standard_prerequisites.use: Invoked at proof line 699 together with Corollary cor: cost to transfer the cost monotonicity to the shifted endpoints; declared as a navigation stub.

standard_prerequisites.name: The cost monotonicity corollary (cor: cost, printed 6.2)
standard_prerequisites.statement: Under the hypothesis of Proposition prop: cost, if each mu_u is a minimizer for E_0^{t'+u,t''+u} with endpoints satisfying the backward heat equation, then u maps to C_0^{t'+u,t''+u}(mu_u(t'+u), mu_u(t''+u)) nondecreasingly.
standard_prerequisites.use: Invoked at proof line 699 to bound the shifted cost quotient by the unshifted one; declared as a navigation stub.

core_obligations: Local smoothness of the minimizing geodesics (proof line 699): using ellipticity of the linearized geodesic equation and an inverse function theorem argument, for t'' sufficiently close to t' and u > 0 sufficiently small, the minimizing geodesic connecting mu(t'+u) and mu(t''+u) is smooth.

Shifted cost monotonicity (proof lines 699-702): by Lemma l:rhoBHE and Corollary cor: cost, the shifted cost quotient dominates the unshifted one, C_0^{t'+u,t''+u}(mu(t'+u), mu''(t''+u))/(t''-t') >= C_0^{t',t''}(mu(t'), mu(t''))/(t''-t').

Difference-quotient limit (proof lines 703-707): letting t'' approach t' converts the cost quotients into half the energy density integral along the flow, giving the two-sided display 1/2 int [|grad phi|^2 + R^{H,f}] dmu at t'+u >= the same at t'.

Density-form substitution (proof line 708): since rho solves eq: heatdensity, grad phi = grad log rho, so the display becomes the nonnegativity of d_t F, i.e. the functional F = int [|grad log rho|^2 + R^{H,f}] dmu is nondecreasing in t.
proof_roadmap: Establish local smoothness of the shifted minimizing geodesics (proof line 699).
Apply the cost monotonicity corollary to the shifted endpoints (proof lines 699-702).
Take the t'' to t' limit of the cost quotients (proof lines 703-707).
Substitute the density-form heat equation to conclude d_t F >= 0 (proof line 708).
